A '''temple''' was used by the [[Peacekeepers]], a nonviolent faction that split from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The temple had [[plaza fountains]], beneath which was a [[hidden chamber]] where the Peacekeepers hid their writings. The temple was deserted<ref name="The Peacekeepers" /> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Peacekeepers" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> when it was discovered.<ref name="The Peacekeepers" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] had a companion go to the temple in order to investigate it. The companion discovered the hidden chamber beneath the [[Water/Legends|fountains]] and delivered the last writings of the Peacekeepers to their associate.<ref name="The Peacekeepers" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Peacekeepers' temple was mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "The Peacekeepers" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Peacekeepers" /> The mission was initially only available to Galactic Republic players<ref name="TORhead">{{WebCite|url=http://www.torhead.com/crew-mission/bVJSnsn/the-peacekeepers|text=The Peacekeepers|work=torhead.com|archivedate=20150317013950}}</ref> though both this restriction and the information about the mission's outcome are no longer part of the game.<ref name="The Peacekeepers" />
